title: Text built from parts
prompt: Return a status line like "Robo has 100 hp" from a name and a number. A number cannot be joined to text directly; it has to be turned into text first.
hints: str() turns a number into text you can join with +.

docs.name: text + text
docs.what: Joins two strings into one. Numbers must be turned into text first.

solution:
func solve(name, hp):
	return name + " has " + str(hp) + " hp"
